# Read-only change set and pricing lookups; mirrors the agent role's policy.
# Mirrors infra/cloudformation/deployment-plan-analysis/deployment-plan-analysis-role.yml.
Bash(aws cloudformation describe-change-set *)
Bash(aws cloudformation describe-stacks *)
Bash(aws cloudformation list-change-sets *)
Bash(aws cloudformation list-stack-resources *)
Bash(aws pricing describe-services *)
Bash(aws pricing get-attribute-values *)
Bash(aws pricing get-products *)
